alt.en: A large bar chart stands at the center of a gray floor, its tallest bar in pink. A dashed orange line carrying one packet runs to it from a sheet of text lying at the left, and a dotted gray line joins it to a closed gray book lying at the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一组大柱状图，最高的一根为粉色。一条带数据包的橙色虚线从左侧平放的文字纸页连到柱状图，一条灰色点线把它与右侧合上的灰色书本相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a text sample feeds a set of detection scores, beside a book standing for the decoding rules the method the TextSeal2 authors describe works within. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show that the reported detection rates hold.
caption.zh: 示意图：一份文本样本连向一组检测分数，旁边的书本代表 TextSeal2 作者所述方法遵循的解码规则。本图并未描绘经过测试的部署，也不表示论文报告的检测率成立。
